correctness.rationale: For every binary two-space \(D=\langle u,v\rangle\), each active coordinate occurs in exactly two of \(u,v,u+v\), so \(2|\operatorname{Supp}(D)|=\operatorname{wt}(u)+\operatorname{wt}(v)+\operatorname{wt}(u+v)\ge216\). The published construction was independently reconstructed from its polynomial and tail data, giving rank \(21\), minimum distance \(72\), and \(9{,}826\) minimum words over all \(2^{21}\) messages. Messages \(0x63,0x318,0x37b\) form an additive triple of weight-\(72\) words with union support \(108\). Exhaustive checking of all \(48{,}270{,}225\) unordered minimum-shell pairs finds \(1{,}748{,}433\) additive pairs, hence exactly \(582{,}811\) minimizing two-spaces after division by the three pairs in each binary two-space.

value.rationale: The second generalized Hamming weight is the first higher support invariant beyond minimum distance. For a newly reported record code, the exact equality \(d_2=108\) shows that the large minimum distance coexists with optimally small two-dimensional support, while the exact \(582{,}811\) multiplicity reveals a substantial additive geometry inside the minimum shell that is invisible from \(d_1\) and \(A_{72}\) alone.
